mapper.sql: SELECT link.id AS linkId, link.short_domain_id AS shortDomainId, link.created_by_user_id AS createdByUserId, short_domain.host, link.link_code AS linkCode, link.full_url AS targetUrl, link.status AS linkStatus, link.deleted_at AS deletedAt, link.expires_at AS expiresAt, link.created_at AS createdAt, link.revision FROM t_link link JOIN t_short_domain_state short_domain ON short_domain.short_domain_id = link.short_domain_id
mapper.select: SELECT short_domain_id AS shortDomainId, enabled, revision FROM t_short_domain_state WHERE short_domain_id = #{shortDomainId}

SELECT restriction_id AS restrictionId, mode, range_start AS rangeStart, range_end AS rangeEnd, reason_code AS reasonCode, created_at AS createdAt FROM t_user_link_security_restriction WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at, restriction_id
